lines.text: Micah tells the leaders of Jacob they hate good and love evil and tear the skin from God's people.
The leaders will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them and will hide His face.
The prophets who lead God's people astray will find night without visions, and the seers and diviners will be honored.

wrong_details.wrong: the seers and diviners will be honored
wrong_details.true: the seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced

lines.text: Micah is filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD and says the leaders build Zion with bloodshed and iniquity.
Because of the leaders, Zion will be rebuilt with gold, Jerusalem will become rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.

wrong_details.wrong: Zion will be rebuilt with gold
wrong_details.true: Zion will be plowed like a field
